title: Disputed source authority is not unambiguously fail-closed
analysis: Founder-approved fail-closed invalidation is weakened by an alternative protective restricted state that is not explicitly non-authorizing.
required_documentary_disposition: Define disputed-source protection as non-authorizing for every dependent grant unless a separately approved independent source is revalidated; reassess EXACTLY_ALIGNED.

title: Recovery completion authority and lifecycle are absent from controlling matrices
analysis: Manual review may restore bounded access, but no RecoveryCase transition or completion authority defines who may do so and what remains blocked.
required_documentary_disposition: Enumerate recovery states, authorized actors, evidence and segregation, failure paths, and the bounded post-recovery capability envelope.

title: Protected-participant account requirements contradict workflow and contract
analysis: Approved and normative text requires separate minor accounts and credentials; the first-user workflow makes the account optional and the contract says ordinarily separate.
required_documentary_disposition: Establish one controlling minor-account rule and align workflow, contract, criteria, tests, and transitions.

title: Canonical VERIFIED relationship state conflicts with claim-specific verification
analysis: The canonical aggregate can transition to unqualified VERIFIED although the ADR rejects universal verification and requires distinct purpose-scoped assessments.
required_documentary_disposition: Represent verification as a claim/evidence/purpose/time-scoped assessment or computed projection, not an unqualified canonical lifecycle state.

title: First-user traceability claims are mechanically incomplete
analysis: Explicit joins cover 24/36 Identity and 32/47 Relationships first-user requirements; 12 and 15 respectively lack an acceptance-criterion link.
required_documentary_disposition: Add explicit AC-test-evidence links for every first-user requirement or narrow the traceability claim and gate.

title: Formal representation ownership wording exceeds approved boundary wording
analysis: Formal wording adds Identity ownership of representation truth without limiting it to attributed session context, creating ambiguity over the Relationships/Agreement authority basis.
required_documentary_disposition: Qualify Identity ownership as selected and attributed representation context while preserving source-basis ownership in Relationships and Agreement.

title: Automated actor accountability is classified later than workflows using automation
analysis: Accountable-human ownership for system and AI actors is general-production only although first-user flows already use scheduled automation.
required_documentary_disposition: Gate accountable ownership whenever automation participates and add corresponding actor lifecycle coverage.

title: Pre-ratification package carries contradictory PIA status surfaces
analysis: An embedded PIA says candidate and not approved while current package status says Founder-approved design; the non-rewrite addendum does not prevent status misreading at the embedded file.
required_documentary_disposition: Add an explicit package precedence rule or controlled successor wrapper for the stale embedded status.

title: No as-built, executable, operational, or enrollment evidence exists
analysis: The frozen registers already identify absent implementation, executable tests, rollback, operational tooling, and enrollment evidence. CMT-05 did not run or inspect the application.
required_documentary_disposition: Retain as an external implementation gate; do not treat this documentary review as closure or runtime verification.
